title: ApprovalDecision
description: What comes back from a human (or a timeout default). This is the learning signal that replaces 'human edit distance'. No free-text editing: a chosen option, or a rejection code from a fixed picker.

decided_by.description: Entra UPN of the ratifier, or 'system:timeout_default'.

was_recommended.description: Derived: chosen_option_id == card.recommended_option_id. Feeds Recommendation Hit Rate.

rejection_code.description: Fixed picker rendered on the card. Replaces free-text feedback so the signal is machine-readable.

rejection_note.description: Optional. Kept short on purpose; if the human is writing paragraphs the card design has failed.

signature.description: Key Vault signature over (card_id, outcome, chosen_option_id, decided_at) - same replay-rejection scheme the gatekeeper already uses.
